connection.description: GitConnections id of the Azure DevOps connection used to authenticate this call.

project.description: Azure DevOps project that will own the new pipeline.

repoId.description: Azure DevOps repository id (or name) the pipeline is defined in.

yamlPath.description: Path (within the repository) to the pipeline YAML file. This action does not generate pipeline YAML content — the file must already exist in the repository (e.g. from an earlier fs:render/git:push step); a missing file surfaces as an Azure DevOps API error.
